newsitem.title: LATVIA: BUDGET DEFICIT 1.31 MLN LATS BY MAY 15.
newsitem.headline: BUDGET DEFICIT 1.31 MLN LATS BY MAY 15.

text.p: Latvia's state budget deficit amounted to 1.31 million lats as of May 15, the finance ministry said on Friday.
Revenues so far this year amounted to 196.837 million lats and expenditure came to 198.148 million lats, the ministry said in a statement.
Internal state debt totalled 416.08 million lats, the ministry added.

This was financed by the sale of Treasury bills worth 139.27 million lats and credits from commercial banks worth 5.34 million lats as well as 64.78 million lats in IMF credits and credits from the World Bank worth 51.39 million lats.
